Borrowed Trust.name: Borrowed Trust
Borrowed Trust.description: Wearing the face of someone the target trusts, such as a teammate, a boss or a relative, the user walks right up to them. The target lets the user within reach, and the user's opening blow, grab or handcuffing lands before they can defend, dodge or shout a warning; a blow deals bludgeoning damage and knocks them down. Strain: moderate.
